wiki.title: Parker Fairbairn
wiki.extract: Parker Fairbairn is an American politician from Michigan who has represented the 107th district in the Michigan House of Representatives since 2025. A member of the Republican Party, Fairbairn defeated then-incumbent representative Neil Friske in the primary, before going on to defeat Democrat Jodi Decker in the general election.
